**What this is.** One page to plan from: the stage table of `docs/PLAN_pipeline.md` §3 and a diagram of how the stages connect.
The two workflows are named by their endpoints and share one contract, the **CRAM store**: the **CRAM workflow** turns raw libraries into
analysis-ready CRAMs once; the **genotype workflow** reads only the store and produces the genotype table, and can be rerun as often as
needed. Mapping (GWAS, interval mapping) sits downstream of the genotype table; it is not a pipeline stage yet (pilots: notebooks 02, 03).
Only decided items are drawn; open proposals are listed in §3.

Solid arrows are data dependencies; the dashed path is optional. Stage 4 (RTIGER) needs only the donor's own discovery (stage 3), so it
runs before the union; step 2 of gap filling and the raster both use it.

## 2. Stages

| # | workflow | entry | what it does | per | main output |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CRAM | `read_demultiplexing` | fetch library → exact inline demultiplexing (cutadapt) → demux QC | library | per-sample FASTQ (task scratch only), `demux_qc/<library>.tsv` |
| 1b | CRAM | `read_trimming` | Trimmomatic (batch-1 parameters) → FastQC | sample | trimmed FASTQ (scratch only), FastQC report |
| 2 | CRAM | `read_alignment` | minibwa `-x sr` → read groups → **mark duplicates** (`samtools markdup -d 2500`) → CRAM without MAPQ filter → samtools stats + markdup stats → Picard CollectWgsMetrics (λ = `MEAN_COVERAGE`, missing = 1 − `PCT_1X`) → MultiQC; no mosdepth | sample | `cram/<sample>.cram` + QC + provenance |
| 2b | genotype | `sample_quality_control` | **exclude samples below 0.05× coverage** from all processing → counts at a blind QC panel → coverage, relatedness and donor-content QC | sample / cohort | `sample_qc.tsv` (pass/fail + reason), read by every later stage |
| 3 | genotype | `variant_discovery` | witness pool → CRISP (BC1 samples + witness) → BED clip → witness veto → B73 control counts → pooled-likelihood tiers | donor × chr | `step4/<donor>.sites.tsv.gz` |
| 4 | genotype | `ancestry_inference` | per-line counts at the donor's own tier-A sites → RTIGER (rigidity 500) | donor × chr | ancestry segments per line |
| 5 | genotype | `marker_union` | union of the donor set's tier-A sites (multi-allelic dropped) | donor set × chr | `union/<set>_<chr>.tsv.gz` |
| 6 | genotype | `donor_allele_calling` | union-site counts → joint pooled likelihood → **gap filling step 1** (BC1) → per-line union counts → **gap filling step 2** (per-line ALT rescue, uses stage 4) → final donor | donor set × chr | donor allele table: ALT / REF / missing per union site |
| 7 | genotype | `genotype_imputation` | raster: genotype = RTIGER ancestry × donor allele (NA where ancestry is unknown, or the line carries the donor segment and the donor allele is missing); optional PHG | donor × chr | genotypes at the union sites |
| 8 | genotype | `reporting` | chromosome paintings, missing-data tables, single-locus checks | donor × chr | paintings, tables |
| — | mapping | (not a stage yet) | GWAS: R-EMMAX, taxon fixed + K random; interval mapping: R/qtl `bcsft` on RTIGER ancestry | trait | scans, thresholds, peaks |

## 3. Status and open proposals (2026-09-27)

| part | status |
|---|---|
| CRAM workflow | pilot CRAMs exist for the two mexicana donors (MAPQ-filtered, no read groups); duplicate marking run on them (array 963772); the production module (no MAPQ filter, read groups) is not built |
| stage 2b | 0.05× exclusion decided (batch 1: 15 samples); the rest is a proposal |
| stages 3–6 | scripts in zealbc1 (`PHG/bin/`) and zealgt `agent/`; step 2 of gap filling validated on the QC set, not yet a module |
| stage 7 | raster built for the pilot (notebook 02); PHG optional (§7 of the plan) |
| mapping | pilots on 83 lines, chr10 (notebooks 02, 03) |
| disk | scratch: group quota 20 TB / 1,000,000 files (78 % of files used); CRAM workflow needs ≈ 1.8–2.1 TB of store and ≤ 1.5 TB scratch peak (§5) |

Open proposals, not yet in the plan or the diagram: the witness counted as a pool for tier A; a B73 check pipeline (per-check QC,
acceptance criterion, one clean check pool counted once, B73-ALT site filter); a coverage calibration step between the workflows; one
per-line count VCF per donor (AD + RTIGER ancestry as a FORMAT field).
